comment: Communities along the full Airport→Ocho Rios route. Each entry triggers a community sign (recognition layer 2). IDs are stable — do not renumber. Entries marked needs_owner_review need the owner's lived knowledge to confirm placement.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The long strip road from the airport — sea on both sides.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: The roundabout where potholes begin — end of the government-maintained airport road.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston industrial and residential area along Windward Road.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: East Kingston hillside community, near Mountain View Avenue.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major junction in Kingston — Half Way Tree Road meets Maxfield Avenue.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's business district — hotels, banks, Emancipation Park.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The clock tower — commercial heart of St. Andrew.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Old colonial capital of Jamaica — Cathedral, old iron bridge.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entry to the Bog Walk gorge — Flat Bridge, Rio Cobre river.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St. Catherine — famous for Linstead Market song.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town between Linstead and Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country junction — Moneague Lake, cool climate, Mount Rosser nearby.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Natural canopy of tree ferns and bamboo — one of Jamaica's most beautiful roads.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: End of the route — Dunn's River Falls, tourist hub on the north coast.
